views.name: v_post_user
views.create_sql: /* Views thu cong cho database codebase_community (Paper V-SQL style) */ /* 1. View ket hop bai dang (posts) va tac gia (users) */ CREATE VIEW v_post_user AS SELECT posts.Id AS post_id, posts.PostTypeId AS post_type_id, posts.Score AS post_score, posts.ViewCount AS view_count, posts.Title AS post_title, posts.Tags AS post_tags, posts.AnswerCount AS answer_count, posts.CommentCount AS comment_count, posts.FavoriteCount AS favorite_count, users.Id AS user_id, users.DisplayName AS author_name, users.Reputation AS author_reputation, users.Location AS author_location, users.Views AS author_views, users.UpVotes AS author_upvotes, users.DownVotes AS author_downvotes FROM posts LEFT JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id

views.name: v_comment_details
views.create_sql: /* 2. View binh luan kem thong tin post va nguoi binh luan */ CREATE VIEW v_comment_details AS SELECT comments.Id AS comment_id, comments.Score AS comment_score, comments.Text AS comment_text, comments.CreationDate AS comment_date, posts.Id AS post_id, posts.Title AS post_title, users.Id AS user_id, users.DisplayName AS commenter_name, users.Reputation AS commenter_reputation FROM comments LEFT JOIN posts ON comments.PostId = posts.Id LEFT JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id
